summary: I confirmed the self-trigger guard empirically — my own memory write woke me but the dispatcher skipped retrieval based on provenance — and then mapped the port surface for headlong: the runtime isn't in my sandbox-visible repo, only skills/ and .identities/, with shellm/SKILL.md documenting the architecture.
